name: AIVA 4-Dimensional Academic Viva Voce Rubric
description: Standardized academic scoring rubric for evaluating university student oral defense responses.

dimensions.name: Technical Correctness
dimensions.description: Veracity, factual precision, and mathematical/algorithmic accuracy of the explanation.

levels.0.0: Completely inaccurate or fundamentally flawed concepts.
levels.0.25: Major factual misconceptions with minor peripheral truths.
levels.0.50: Partially correct; grasps high-level concept but contains minor technical errors.
levels.1.00: Flawless technical precision adhering strictly to domain principles.

dimensions.name: Facet Completeness
dimensions.description: Extent to which all core aspects of the multi-part question are addressed.

levels.0.25: Addresses only a single peripheral aspect while omitting the core question.
levels.0.50: Covers approximately half of the required components.
levels.0.75: Covers all major components with minor brevity in one facet.
levels.1.00: Exhaustively addresses every component and implication of the prompt.

dimensions.name: Project Report Grounding
dimensions.description: Consistency with facts, architectural parameters, and implementation details documented in the student's report.

levels.0.0: Directly contradicts the submitted project report.
levels.0.25: Describes generic concepts completely divorced from the project implementation.
levels.0.50: Mentions project components with loose or generic alignment.
levels.0.75: Accurately references specific libraries, hyper-parameters, and pipeline stages.
levels.1.00: Perfect fidelity to empirical figures, configuration settings, and architectural diagrams.

dimensions.name: Architectural Rationale & Trade-offs
dimensions.description: Student's ability to articulate 'why' specific choices were made and critically evaluate alternative methods.

levels.0.0: Pure rote recitation without any explanatory rationale.
levels.0.25: Superficial rationale ('it was faster') without technical substance.
levels.0.50: Explains rationale but fails to articulate operational trade-offs or failure modes.
levels.0.75: Articulates clear engineering trade-offs (e.g., latency vs accuracy, memory vs compute).
levels.1.00: Comprehensive synthesis of trade-offs, theoretical bounds, and architectural alternatives.
